content.title: Fix shadcn-ui theme/CSS so all components render with correct styles
content.description: Based on the validator's reproduction and root-cause analysis, fix the styling issue so that inputs, select boxes, modals, and all shadcn-ui components render correctly with proper backgrounds, borders, and text contrast.\n\nLikely areas: global CSS import, Tailwind configuration (content globs, theme extension), shadcn-ui theme variable definitions, or component class resolution. Apply the fix and verify in the running webapp.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqgza7xio7 transitioned to done

content.content:
## Done — shadcn-ui theme/CSS restored

### Root cause
`src/index.css` was missing the entire shadcn theme definition. Under Tailwind v4, semantic utilities like `bg-background`, `border-input`, `text-muted-foreground`, `ring-ring`, etc. are only generated when you declare them via a `@theme inline` block **plus** `:root` / `.dark` blocks giving them concrete values. None existed, so Tailwind emitted zero rules for those classes and every `components/ui/*` component rendered transparent/unstyled.

### Fix applied (single file: `packages/webapp/frontend/src/index.css`)
1. Added the standard shadcn `neutral` token set (`:root` + `.dark` blocks) for background, foreground, card, popover, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, chart-*, and sidebar-*.
2. Added a `@theme inline` block mapping each semantic var to its `--color-*` Tailwind token so the utilities now generate real CSS rules.
3. Imported `tw-animate-css` (already a dependency but never imported) — needed for the `animate-in` / `fade-in-0` / `zoom-in-95` / `slide-in-from-*` classes used by Dialog, Select, DropdownMenu, Tooltip, etc.
4. Added a `@layer base` block so the page defaults to `bg-background` / `text-foreground` and borders fall back to `--border`.
5. While in the same file, defined the previously-undefined agentrack design tokens that were the same bug class: `--agentrack-transition-duration-{fast,normal,slow}` (used by the transition utilities) and `--agentrack-color-status-{idea,todo,in-progress,done,closed}` / `--agentrack-color-priority-{p1..p5}` (used by StatusBadge / PriorityIndicator, which would otherwise have rendered invisible status/priority colors). Light + dark values provided.

### Verification
- `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json` → PASS, no type errors.
- `bun run build` → PASS, no CSS warnings. Built CSS grew from ~41 kB to ~58 kB (the semantic rules now emit). Confirmed in the built CSS that `:root` contains the shadcn tokens and that rules like `.bg-background{background-color:var(--background)}` now exist (previously absent).
- E2E suite: **174/174 passed** (Playwright, ~47s) — no regressions.
- Lint: no lint script/config exists for the webapp frontend, so nothing to run.

### Note (out of scope)
`@fontsource-variable/geist` is listed as a dependency but is never imported anywhere in `src/`, so the intended Geist font is not currently loading. This is cosmetic and outside this issue's scope; flagging for triage.
